dashboard.connectFirstBody: You haven't connected any Shopify store yet. Connect one to start importing and publishing products.

landing.metaTitle: xcart — Clone any store to Shopify in minutes
landing.metaDesc: Import products from Shopify, WooCommerce, Shoplazza and AliExpress, translate, neutralize images with AI and publish straight to your Shopify. Routed checkout and full store setup.
landing.heroBadge: Imports from Shopify, WooCommerce, Shoplazza and AliExpress
landing.heroSubtitle: Import products, translate for your audience, neutralize images with AI and publish straight to your Shopify. All in one tool.
landing.heroNote: Unlimited cloning · Automatic translation · {credits} images/mo included
landing.featuresTitle: Everything to build the store fast
landing.featuresSubtitle: From import to publish, no repetitive manual work.

features.title: Import from any source
features.desc: Shopify, WooCommerce, Shoplazza and AliExpress. Paste the link and xcart detects the platform and pulls products, variants, prices and images.

features.title: Automatic translation
features.desc: Titles, descriptions and variants translated to Portuguese or Spanish with AI, in the right tone for your audience.

features.title: Image neutralization
features.desc: Removes brands and watermarks from photos with AI. Images upload ready to Shopify — you spend 1 credit per image.

features.title: Routed checkout
features.desc: Separate showcase and checkout stores. The cart is resolved by SKU at runtime, with per-market currency and domain.

features.title: Full store setup
features.desc: Policies, menus, pages (About, Contact, Tracking, FAQ) and footer generated and published in one click.

features.title: Unlimited cloning
features.desc: Clone as many stores and products as you want. No quantity limit — only neutralized images use credits.

landing.howSubtitle: Four steps from link to live store.

steps.title: Connect your Shopify
steps.desc: Paste the domain and app credentials. Token refreshed automatically.

steps.title: Paste the source store link
steps.desc: xcart detects the platform and imports everything: products, variants and photos.

steps.title: Translate and neutralize
steps.desc: AI adapts the text to your audience and cleans brands off the images.

steps.title: Publish
steps.desc: Products live on your Shopify, with routed checkout if you want.
